newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania harvests 33 pct of 1996 maize crop.
newsitem.headline: Romania harvests 33 pct of 1996 maize crop.

text.p: Romania has harvested 33 percent of its 1996 maize crop and estimates put this year's output at 8.91 million tonnes, compared to last year's bumper crop of 9.678 million tonnes, the farm ministry said.
"So far, we harvested 2.99 million tonnes of maize from 1.11 million hectares," ministry spokeswoman Aurelia Ioan said by telephone.
Average yield was 2,683 kg per hectare, slighlty lower than initial estimates of 2,712 kg, Ioan said.
Maize harvesting is usually completed by end-November.
Last year, Romania exported some 1.0 million tonnes of maize.
Annual domestic consumption amounts to around 8.0 million tonnes.
Last month, the ministry said it planned to export some 1.5 million tonnes of maize from this year's crop.
